{{Infobox NCAA athlete | name = Darius Miller | nickname = | image = Darius-Miller.jpg | color = | fontcolor = | college = [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]] | conference = [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] | sport = [[Basketball]] | jersey = | position = [[Guard]] / [[Forward]] | class = Senior | career_start = | height_ft = 6 | height_in = 8 | weight_lb = 235 | nationality = [[United States|American]] | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1990|3|21}} | birth_place = | highschool = Mason County High School | career_highlights = | awards = }} '''Darius Miller''' (born March 21, 1990){{cite web|url=http://rivals.yahoo.com/ncaa/basketball/players/82099|title=Darius Miller — Kentucky Wildcats — College Basketball — Rivals.com|work=[[Yahoo!]]|accessdate=April 3, 2012}} is an American [[college basketball]] player. He last played at the [[University of Kentucky]] and finished his senior season by winning the [[2012 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament]] on the [[2011–12 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|2011–12 Kentucky Wildcats]] team. Miller graduated from Mason County High School in 2008 after leading the school to a state championship.{{cite web|url=http://nbadraft.net/players/darius-miller|title=Darius Miller | NBADraft.net|accessdate=April 3, 2012}} After his senior season in high school, Miller was named the KHSAA's men's basketball player of the year, commonly known as "[[Kentucky_Mr._Basketball|Kentucky Mr. Basketball]]". Following Kentucky's 2012 national championship win Miller was chosen to present a commemorative Kentucky jersey to President [[Barack Obama]] during the team's visit to the White House on May 4, 2012. During the visit, Obama noted that Miller is the only player from Kentucky to have been named Kentucky's "Mr. Basketball" (high school player of the year in the state), win a KHSAA state championship (Mason County High School) and claim an NCAA title with the University of Kentucky.{{cite web|url=http://www.kentucky.com/2012/05/04/2175858/kentucky-basketball-teams-meeting.html|title=President Barack Obama honors Kentucky basketball champions|accessdate=May 5, 2012}} Miller finished his college career having played more games for the University of Kentucky than any other player{{cite web|url=http://www.bigbluehistory.net/bb/Statistics/careergamesplayed.html|title=Kentucky career leaders in games played | Big Blue History|accessdate=May 5, 2012}}. The Wildcats' championship game and Miller's last collegiate match, was his 152nd appearance for the team, surpassing [[Wayne_Turner|Wayne Turner]]'s previous record of 151 games. Accolades:
• NCAA National Championship (2012) • SEC Sixth Man of the Year (2012) • SEC All-Academic Team (2012) • 2011 World University Games (USA) • SEC Tournament MVP (2011) • SEC All-Tournament Team (2011) • 2009 U-19 World Championships (USA) • Kentucky Mr. Basketball (2008) • Parade All-American Third Team (2008)
